limitations: Authored strictly from canonical documentation/ and source.json without inspecting prior frozen benchmark cases, results, or retrieval code.
Provider authentication guidance is consolidated at documentation/provider/setup/index.md without property sub-anchors.
Schema collisions between resource and data-source variants (e.g., origin_pool, http_loadbalancer) require explicit resource role context in prompts.
